interfaces.studio_readiness_report: Optional bounded read-only local process snapshot from canonical build/desktop/core inventories; separate authenticated server projection from existing /api/game-studio-health.
interfaces.doctor: app doctor --studio [--live --auth-token-file PRIVATE_FILE] --json; no raw token argument, provider call, model load, game/core execution or crawl.
interfaces.toolchains: Existing install_game_desktop_toolchains.py selects explicit --tool names; no network without --download, local archive/source cache supported; existing --cc65/--rgbds accepted without acquiring unrequested Go/SDL.

invariants: Keep five existing services and existing canonical data owners; no shadow emulator, builder, trainer or knowledge store.
Host toolchain availability is explicitly scoped to this CLI process, never treated as readiness inside another container/server.
Approved core ELF/firmware checks do not execute native code, prove title compatibility, approve ROM rights or establish complete hardware emulation.
No default games, ROMs, BIOS, firmware, proprietary SDKs or model weights are acquired.
Offline provisioning never starts fetch/clone/submodule/network commands; archives/source revision and immutable output receipts must be checked before reuse.
Compile only fixed pinned public build-tool sources; use stripped compiler environment, bounded private logs, single build job and process-group timeout cleanup.
Do not reuse partially installed or altered SDK directories as trusted completed installs; installation publishes atomically from private staging and records exact source/tool/license identities.
Existing approved-core installer remains authoritative and already requires explicit --fetch-sources; recipes/candidates are distinct from installed approval and actual gameplay qualification.

The default backend Alpine image does not gain native glibc tooling or weakened sandbox permissions; doctor must report the actual server prerequisites and direct operators to supported Linux host configuration.

Dragon bootstrap creates only empty existing schemas under backend_data, is idempotent and fail-closed on unsafe/corrupt state, and grants no reviewed knowledge, scheduler authority, model calls or training rights.
Authenticated readiness sends a private operator token only to configured HTTPS backend or loopback HTTP; diagnostics return no tokens or raw exceptions.
Local and authenticated HTTP probes run in bounded one-shot subprocesses; a slow peer cannot leave a detached diagnostic thread or retain the parent beyond its wall deadline.
